name: Cambodia

seo.title: Cambodia travel guide | Pareto Travel
seo.description: A practical Cambodia travel guide covering itinerary ideas, the best months to visit, cuisine, transport, budget, FAQs, and ratings.

overview: Cambodia felt like a trip to the past, but in a good way (see India for the bad way). While the temples of Angkor Wat take you back to medieval times, Siem Reap has a Cold War-era vibe. We found the Cambodian people earnest and endearing, which makes it shocking to think the country witnessed a genocide only 50 years ago. Overall, we recommend Cambodia for its temples and tranquility.
